bio.text: Ken Block, a software engineer from Barrington, announced on April 2, 2026 that he is running for Rhode Island governor as an independent, his third campaign for the office.
He ran for governor in 2010 as the candidate of the Moderate Party, which he founded, finishing fourth with 6.5 percent of the vote, and in 2014 lost the Republican primary to Allan Fung.

He runs the data mining company Simpatico Software Systems; his campaign website says he was a leading voice in the campaign that led state lawmakers in 2013 to eliminate the "master lever" for straight-party voting.

sources.title: Ken Block is running for governor again. This time as an independent.
